intro: Use the present subjunctive of poder — pueda, puedas, podamos, puedan — after expressions that create a second clause: need, doubt, permission, purpose, or possibility.

overview.body: Poder means can or to be able to. In the present subjunctive, it often appears after que or para que because the action depends on another idea: someone needs it, doubts it, allows it, or wants it to be possible.

examples.english: I need you to be able to come early.

examples.spanish: Te llamo para que podamos hablar.
examples.english: I am calling you so that we can talk.

forms.label: yo / él / ella / usted pueda
forms.meaning: I / he / she / you formal can

structure.example: Necesito que puedas leer este mensaje.
structure.translation: I need you to be able to read this message.

structure.example: Dudo que él pueda llegar a tiempo.
structure.translation: I doubt he can arrive on time.

structure.example: Te envío la dirección para que puedas encontrar la casa.
structure.translation: I am sending you the address so you can find the house.

structure.example: La profesora deja que podamos usar el diccionario.
structure.translation: The teacher lets us use the dictionary.

uses.heading: Need or request
uses.body: Use the subjunctive when one person needs, asks, or wants another person to be able to do something.

examples.spanish: Quiero que puedas descansar esta noche.
examples.english: I want you to be able to rest tonight.

examples.spanish: Necesitamos que ustedes puedan entrar al sistema.
examples.english: We need you all to be able to enter the system.

uses.heading: Doubt or uncertainty
uses.body: Use the subjunctive when the ability is not presented as a fact.

examples.spanish: No creo que ella pueda venir hoy.
examples.english: I do not think she can come today.

examples.spanish: Dudo que podamos terminar antes de las seis.
examples.english: I doubt we can finish before six.

uses.heading: Purpose
uses.body: Use para que when the second action explains the purpose of the first action.

examples.spanish: Hablo despacio para que puedas entender.
examples.english: I speak slowly so you can understand.

examples.spanish: Abrimos la ventana para que puedan respirar mejor.
examples.english: We open the window so they can breathe better.
